provenance.purpose: Exploratory development-only candidate screen; no deployed policy or confirmatory test.
provenance.input_scope: Exact existing observable banks and masks. No generation or reading of test anchors, channel truth or path counts.
provenance.inference: One original estimate and one EM trajectory per fit; shared spectral100 across fits. Blends are (1-alpha)*left+alpha*right. No fitting or heldout loss enters a prediction.
provenance.comparison: Paired per-anchor loss differences averaged over three frozen model fits; all four incumbents (original, old bypass, previous transition repair, current dual guard).
provenance.bootstrap: Existing4000 multinomial384 count vectors per regime, shared over all bins and candidates. Strict upper95<=0 in each regime for every incumbent; no preference band or tolerance.
provenance.interpretation: Exploratory reused development evidence; no population guarantee, selection commitment or training-uncertainty claim.
